tagline: Get READY to open your doors with confidence every day.
hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI represents 77% of Cintas' total revenue, demonstrating the strength of its core uniform rental and facility services business.

kpis.short: Revenu segment Uniform Rental and Facility Services
kpis.name: Uniform Rental and Facility Services Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the rental and servicing of uniforms, mats, towels, restroom supplies, and other facility-related services.
kpis.description: Cintas' largest segment, reflecting sustained demand for its corporate identity and workplace cleanliness services.

kpis.short: Revenu segment First Aid and Safety Services
kpis.name: First Aid and Safety Services Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from first aid, safety, and workplace water services products and services.
kpis.description: This segment includes essential employee safety and wellness offerings, showing increasing demand.
kpis.signal: Strong growth, outpacing the core segment.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Sum of all revenue generated by the company's various business activities.
kpis.description: A key indicator of Cintas' overall financial performance, showing continued business expansion.
kpis.signal: Solid overall growth, driven by both segments.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting cost of goods sold (COGS).
kpis.description: Gross margin is improving, indicating better management of production and service costs.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting operating expenses (OPEX).
kpis.description: Operating margin is expanding, suggesting increased efficiency in managing operating expenses.

kpis.name: R&D Investments (% of Revenue)
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenditures expressed as a percentage of total revenue.
kpis.description: Not available: Cintas does not explicitly report R&D expenses as a percentage of revenue in its 10-K.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on physical assets for the acquisition or upgrading of tangible assets.
kpis.description: Not available: Specific details on capital expenditures (CAPEX) are not provided in the 10-K excerpts supplied.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working for the company.
kpis.description: Not available: Employee count is not reported in the provided 10-K excerpts.

kpis.name: All Other Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from operating segments not classified as primary, including Fire Protection and Direct Uniform Sales.
kpis.description: This smaller segment shows steady growth and contributes to Cintas' revenue diversification.

kpis.short: Revenu segment First Aid and Safety Services
kpis.name: First Aid and Safety Services Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from first aid, safety, and workplace water services products and services.
kpis.description: Strong growth in this segment indicates rising demand for workplace safety and wellness solutions.
kpis.signal: Accelerating growth in a key segment.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale. Indicateur clé pour les investisseurs orientés revenus.
kpis.description: 5-year history of declared dividends per share (2021-2025).

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel du cash redistribué aux actionnaires : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury stock).
kpis.description: For 2025: cumulative dividends + share buybacks in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée en dividendes. Au-dessus de 80 % indique un dividende potentiellement non-soutenable.
kpis.description: Dividends / net income for 2025 (based on net income attributable to shareholders).

kpis.name: Uniform Rental & Services Revenue
kpis.explanation: Chiffre d'affaires généré par la location et l'entretien d'uniformes, tapis, serviettes, fournitures de salle de bain et autres services liés aux installations.
kpis.description: Cintas' largest segment, reflecting sustained demand for corporate identity and workplace cleanliness services.

kpis.name: First Aid & Safety Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Chiffre d'affaires provenant des produits et services de premiers secours, de sécurité et de services d'eau en milieu de travail.
kpis.description: This segment includes essential employee safety and wellness services, demonstrating growing demand.

kpis.name: Fire Protection Services Revenue
kpis.description: Minority segment but steady 2-digit growth trajectory.
kpis.signal: Minority segment with consistent double-digit growth.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Conversion FCF >75% NI, finance buybacks + M&A
kpis.description: FCF conversion >75% NI, funds buybacks and M&A.
kpis.signal: FCF conversion >75% of Net Income, funding buybacks and M&A.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Croissance mesurée, productivité par tête en hausse
kpis.description: Measured headcount growth, productivity per employee on the rise.
kpis.signal: Measured growth with improving per-employee productivity.

risks.title: Intense Competition
risks.score_rationale: The garment rental and safety services industry is highly competitive, with numerous players offering similar services. Cintas must maintain its competitive advantage through innovation and service quality.

risks.title: Growth Dependent on Sales Volumes
risks.score_rationale: Cintas' growth relies heavily on increasing sales volumes and customer penetration. An economic slowdown could reduce demand for these services.

risks.title: Acquisition-Related Risks
risks.score_rationale: Cintas has pursued acquisitions for growth (0.8% growth driven by acquisitions in FY2025). These transactions carry integration risks, overvaluation risks, and debt management challenges.

risks.title: Debt-Related Risks
risks.score_rationale: Cintas maintains a debt structure to finance acquisitions and operations. Rising interest rates or a downgrade in credit quality could increase financing costs.

risks.title: Dependence on Reputation and Service Quality
risks.score_rationale: Cintas serves over one million customers. Its reputation and service quality are critical for customer retention and growth. Any major incident would have a significant impact.

risks.title: Regulatory Compliance and Environmental Standards
risks.score_rationale: Cintas operates in laundry services, safety products, and fire protection, all subject to strict regulations (EPA, OSHA, etc.). Regulatory changes could increase compliance costs.

ai_positioning.summary: CTAS does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its annual report.
